description: Draw a sequence diagram (who sends what to whom, in order) in the chat. YOU write it as Mermaid sequenceDiagram text (first line "sequenceDiagram"; "participant S as Server"; arrows A->>B: text for a call and B-->>A: text for a reply). This tool returns a finished diagram that the view draws inline (MCP Apps hosts; elsewhere the text fallback lists the messages). Call it with the Mermaid you wrote and show the result as it is: do not edit, re-encode or re-send the returned block, and do not pass it to render_surface. If it is refused, the message names the line and what to fix; correct the Mermaid and call again. Limits: 8192 bytes, at most 6 actors and 14 messages; longer flows should be split into several diagrams (one per phase). Supported: participant/actor (with "as" aliases), implicit participants, ->>, -->>, -), ->, -->, autonumber, title. activate/deactivate are ignored (not drawn). Not supported: Note, loop/alt/opt/par/critical/rect blocks. Labels are plain text (60 characters), no HTML or links.

mermaid.description:
Mermaid sequenceDiagram text you wrote, for example: sequenceDiagram
  participant U as User
  participant A as Auth service
  U->>A: Log in
  A-->>U: Token

title.description: Optional title shown above the diagram (plain text, 80 characters at most). A "title" line in the Mermaid is used when this is absent.

name: draw_sequence

blocks.description: One laid-out sequence block for the view.
